newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 417,000 barrels in the week ended Oct 11 to 301.89 million barrels from 302.30 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 232,000 barrels in the week to 233.49 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 673,000 barrels to 114.32 million from 113.65 million the previous week. PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 917,000 barrels to 38.23 million barrels.
API said gasoline stocks fell 509,000 barrels in the week to 195.81 million barrels from 196.32 million barrels. Percent of capacity fell to 92.7 percent from 94.9 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 1.46 million barrels to 39.21 million barrels from 37.75 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 14.10 million barrels from 14.44 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 36.96 million barrels from 35.64 million in the previous week, and crude oil imports fell to 7.27 million barrels per day from 7.89 million, API said.
